title: The Foresight Brief: Chokepoints Past, Present and Future | World Economic Forum
gist: Landing page for a World Economic Forum / Atlantic Council foresight report arguing that global chokepoints (trade, resource, digital and emerging space-based connectors) concentrate economic value with few alternatives, making them fragile points whose disruption cascades across systems. It urges governments and businesses to map critical dependencies, diversify alternatives and build resilience before crises.

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum argues that global chokepoints are vulnerable because they concentrate economic value and influence while offering limited alternatives, so a disruption at one can trigger consequences across global systems.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Concentration plus lack of substitutes is the screen for tail-risk exposure: assets and supply chains dependent on single-route connectors carry underpriced disruption risk.
insights.quote: their concentration of economic value and influence, combined with limited alternatives, makes them vulnerable, and disruption can trigger consequences across global systems
insights.locator: The global economy depends on a network of critical connections

insights.claim: Drawing on historical examples and regional case studies, the WEF/Atlantic Council chokepoints report highlights how disruptions at strategic connectors cascade across interconnected systems.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Expect second-order effects from chokepoint shocks to spread beyond the directly affected route or sector; model contagion, not just the first-order hit.
insights.locator: Drawing on historical examples and regional case studies

insights.claim: The WEF and Atlantic Council analyse chokepoints through four lenses: economics, geopolitics, governance and ecology.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: A reusable checklist for assessing any strategic connector's risk: price/value concentration, state rivalry, rule-setting control and climate/ecological exposure.
insights.locator: It examines chokepoints through four lenses

insights.claim: The WEF/Atlantic Council report extends the chokepoint concept beyond physical trade routes to digital infrastructure, climate-change effects and emerging space-based dependencies.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Future chokepoint risk may sit in data infrastructure and space assets, not only shipping lanes; watch these as new concentration and resilience-spending themes.
insights.locator: exploring the impact of digital infrastructure, climate change and emerging space-based dependencies

insights.claim: The WEF/Atlantic Council chokepoints report calls on governments and businesses to practise strategic anticipation by identifying critical dependencies, diversifying alternatives and building resilience before crises occur.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Signals continued policy and corporate push toward redundancy and diversification of routes and suppliers, supporting resilience-related capex.
insights.quote: identifying critical dependencies, diversifying alternatives and building resilience before crises occur
insights.locator: It calls on governments and businesses to practise strategic anticipation
